105. The recently completed IMF-World Bank Financial Sector Assessment

Program provides additional insights. This in-depth review, the first for Nepal, of all

aspects of the financial sector has helped identify specific reforms that can be integrated

into the Strategy and the government's medium- to long-term reform agenda for the

financial sector.

106. DFID is working in close partnership and coordination with the World Bank

on financial sector issues. DFID has given strong technical assistance and capacity-
